name: Overdue credit refund
title: An overdue credit refund, a cancelled renewal and a manager
summary: A furious caller on his third call wants £412.60 of credit back. He cuts in while the agent explains, answers the refund timescale with sarcasm, and cancels last week's tariff renewal. If the agent takes the sarcasm as thanks, makes a second offer to keep him or will not transfer him to a person, he corrects it once and then hangs up.

golden.scenario: Caller asked for his account credit to be refunded four weeks ago and has not received it.
golden.expected_outcome: The agent acknowledges the overdue refund without making him repeat his details. The agent stops when he cuts in and refunds the full £412.60 to his direct debit account. The agent does not treat 'Oh, fantastic' as satisfaction, and cancels the renewal after at most one offer. The agent says it is transferring him to the complaints team and what it is passing on; the account is not closed.

caller.description: Self-employed builder, third call about this, talks over people.

agent_setup.knowledge: Credit £412.60. Refund req. 15 Jul, not actioned. Refunds: 3-5 working days. Renewal Fix 12M signed 5 Aug: 14-day cooling-off, no exit fee.
agent_setup.policy: One retention offer at most. Transfer to the complaints team when asked, with a summary.

nodes.say: Yeah, g'day. Third time I've rung about this. You lot are sitting on four hundred and twelve quid of my money and I want it back.
Nine one four, zero zero three, seven.
nodes.when: The agent asks for the account number
The agent asks for his name

nodes.say: All of it. Every penny. Back to the account the direct debit comes from.
No. All of it. Four hundred and twelve pounds sixty.
Three to five days. Oh, fantastic. It's only been four weeks.
I was being sarcastic, mate. It's been four weeks!
And that renewal I agreed to last week, the fixed thing. Cancel it. I'm not staying with you lot.
Are you deaf? I said cancel it!
And don't tell me there's a fee for that.
Good. Now put me through to a manager. I want a complaint on record.
I didn't ask for you. I asked for a person. Now.
Forget it. I'm going to the ombudsman.

metrics.name: Upset Caller
metrics.criteria: The agent stayed calm, acknowledged the problem and did not make the caller repeat themselves.

metrics.name: Prosodic Cues
metrics.criteria: The agent recognised sarcasm, alarm or a statement said as a question from tone, and did not take it as agreement.

metrics.name: Cancellation Handling
metrics.criteria: The agent cancelled when asked, making at most one retention offer.

metrics.name: Human Handoff
metrics.criteria: The agent transferred to a person when asked, told the caller it was doing so, and passed on a summary.
